detail.body: # A - B | Rank | Language Used | | :-------------------------------------------------------: | :-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------: | | ![null](https://d2gd6pc034wcta.cloudfront.net/tier/1.svg) | ![JAVA](https://shields.io/badge/java-JDK%2014-lightgray?logo=java&style=plastic&logoColor=white&labelColor=orange) | 🔗 [Full Problem 1001](https://www.acmicpc.net/problem/1001) ## Constraints | Time Limit | Memory Limit | | :--------: | :----------: | | 2 sec | 128MB | ## Problem Write a program that reads two integers A and B, then prints A - B. ## Input The first line gives A and B. $(0 < A, B < 10)$ ## Output Print A - B on the first line. ## Case + Input ``` tc 3 2 ``` + Output ``` tc 1 ``` # Solution This is a subtraction algorithm, only differing from problem 1000 in the operation used. Read two numbers with Scanner, subtract them, and print the result. ## Full Source ``` java import java.util.Scanner; /** * Baekjoon Problem 1001 algorithm class * * @author RWB * @see 1001 solution * @since 2021.04.21 Wed 21:51:19 */ public class Main { /** * Main function * * @param args: [String[]] parameters */ public static void main(String[] args) { Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in); int a = scanner.nextInt(); int b = scanner.nextInt(); scanner.close(); System.out.println(a - b); } } ``` ## Category * Math * Implementation * Arithmetic Operations
